capture.acquiringBody: The camera unlocks once the fix is accurate enough to pin the incident.
capture.cameraPermissionBody: Dawuro needs the camera and microphone to record incident evidence.
capture.recordFailedBody: The camera ended the recording before it finished. Please film it again.
capture.liveBody: It will let a monitoring room watch an incident as it happens and send the nearest unit while you are still there. Record a video for now — it reaches the same organisations.
capture.liveTitle: Live streaming is not switched on yet
capture.mockedBody: Your device is reporting a simulated position. This report will be flagged.
capture.permissionDeniedBody: Dawuro stamps every report with GPS coordinates so responders can find the scene. Without location access the camera stays locked.
capture.servicesDisabledBody: Turn on location services for your device to capture an incident.
capture.stalledBody: Buildings and thick cover block satellites. Step outside or away from walls to sharpen the fix.

common.unknownErrorHelp: Check your connection and try again.

both.title: Public and organisations
both.body: An editor reviews it for the feed, and organisations can license it.

directed.title: Send to specific organisations
directed.body: An editor reviews it, then only the ones you choose receive it. Exclusive, so it pays more.

destination.earningHelp: Paid once an organisation licenses this report.
destination.label: Where should this go?

marketplace.title: Offer to organisations
marketplace.body: An editor reviews it, then subscribing organisations can license it. You earn a commission.

destination.noEarningHelp: Choose a organisation option above to earn a commission.

public.title: Public feed
public.body: An editor reviews it, then it runs on the feed for everyone. No payment — visibility is the reward.

destination.directoryFailedBody: Your report is safe. Send it to the public feed instead, or try again when you have a connection.
destination.noOrganisationsTitle: No organisations are taking reports yet
destination.noOrganisationsBody: Nobody has signed up to receive reports in your area. Send it to the public feed so people can still see it.
destination.nobodyBuyingHelp: No organisation has joined the platform, so nothing can be licensed and nothing can be paid. Sending to the public feed still gets it seen.

detail.contributions: {{count}} people added footage of the same thing
detail.directionsFailedBody: No maps app or browser responded on this device.
detail.locationHidden: The reporter chose not to publish this location. It is still recorded for review.
detail.reportBody: Tell us this report is inaccurate, staged, or unsafe to show. A moderator will review it.
detail.reportedBody: A moderator will review this report.

earn.filmBody: Send it to organisations who need it and get paid when they license it.
earn.inDemandHelp: Reports in these categories reach a buyer fastest.
earn.title: Earn
earn.noDemand: No organisation is buying footage yet. You can still file reports to the public feed — they just will not earn anything until agencies join.

earnings.howBody: You earn when an organisation licenses a report you sent to organisations. Public feed reports do not earn — the reward there is reach. Urgent categories, video, and exclusive submissions pay more.
earnings.mismatchNotice: Your balance is being recalculated. If it still looks wrong after a refresh, contact support.
earnings.simulationNotice: Simulation only — no money moves. A real payout needs a mobile-money integration and identity checks.
earnings.thresholdRemaining: {{amount}} more to reach the payout minimum
earnings.title: Earnings

error.boundaryBody: You can go back and try again. Your captured reports are saved on this device and were not affected.
error.boundaryTitle: This screen ran into a problem

feed.emptyBody: No published reports yet. Be the first to file one.
feed.errorBody: The feed could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
feed.noMatchesBody: Try another category, or clear the search.
feed.shareVerify: Check this report at Dawuro — reference {{id}}
feed.title: Near you

map.emptyBody: Reports appear here once a newsroom or agency releases them. Nothing is hidden from you.
map.unavailableBody: This phone could not reach the service. The map is empty because nothing loaded, not because nothing happened.

anonymous.title: Report anonymously
anonymous.body: Publish without a profile. A device identifier is still recorded so abuse can be traced — we will not pretend otherwise.

earn.title: You are paid when it is used
earn.body: When an institution licenses your footage, you earn a commission on it. Filing is free and always will be.

field.title: Built for the field
field.body: The camera waits for an accurate GPS fix, so your footage carries proof of where it was taken. No signal? It saves to your phone and sends itself when you are back.

gps.title: Verified location, every time
gps.body: The camera unlocks only once your phone has an accurate GPS fix, so every report can be found on the ground.

offline.title: Works without signal
offline.body: Capture anywhere. Reports are saved on your phone and upload themselves the moment you are back online.

reaches.title: It reaches someone who can act
reaches.body: Your report goes to the organisations whose job it is — the Assembly, NADMO, the utility. You can see which ones have it, and what each of them did about it.

what.title: Film what is happening
what.body: A blocked drain, a fire, a pole down across the path. If you can see it, you can report it — and the Ghana News Agency stands behind what gets published.

org.categoryRequiredBody: A query with no categories matches nothing.
org.mapHint: Tap the map or drag the pin to move the centre.
org.nameRequiredBody: Give it a name your team will recognise.
org.noPermission: Your role does not have access to this.

org.pushAlertsHelp: Notify this organisation when a new report matches.
org.querySavedBody: Matching reports will appear in your inbox.
org.suppressedNote: Reports whose reporter hid the location are never matched by a geofence, including for paying organisations.

outbox.emptyBody: Captured reports queue here and upload themselves as soon as you're online.
outbox.explainer: Reports upload one at a time, oldest first, and resume automatically after a dropped connection.
outbox.sentBody: It is with Dawuro now. You will see here what organisations do about it.
outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.mediaGone: The recording is no longer on this phone, so this cannot be sent.
outbox.mediaEmpty: This recording is empty — nothing was captured. Film it again to send it.
outbox.allSentBody: Everything on this phone has been sent. Find what you have filed under Profile.

platform.approvalConsequence: Approving grants this organisation access to footage submitted by the public, including reports of people in distress.
platform.approvedBody: They can now receive routed reports.
platform.payoutSimulation: Simulation only. No money moves. A real payout run needs a mobile-money provider and a settlement account.
platform.rejectedAppBody: They will be emailed the outcome.
platform.rejectedBody: The reporter will see the reason on their report.
platform.releaseWarning: This sends {{amount}} to {{count}} reporters. It cannot be undone.
platform.routedBody: It now appears in their inboxes.

profile.noneInStateBody: You have reports, just none matching this filter.
profile.pendingExplainer: Waiting for review. It will appear publicly once approved.
profile.reportsErrorBody: Your reports are safe. This phone just could not reach the server to list them.
profile.withdrawBody: It comes off the feed and out of the review queue, and you cannot undo it. The record is kept for lawful process, and any organisation that has already licensed it keeps their copy.
profile.withdrawnBody: It is no longer in the queue or on the feed.

published.creditedTo: Credited to {{name}} on the public feed

review.anonymitySheetBody: The public and other users see no profile on your report — it appears as Anonymous.
review.anonymitySheetDevice: A device identifier is still attached to the submission so abuse can be traced. We will not overstate this: it is not untraceable.
review.anonymousShort: Your profile stays hidden from the public.
review.posterHelp: Pick the moment that best shows what you are reporting.

review.distressingHelp: Blood, bodies, or people in severe distress.
review.emergencyBody: Dawuro is not an emergency service. If people are in danger right now, call {{number}} before you file this.

handling.viewer_warning: Viewers get a warning before it plays.
handling.restrict_location: The exact location will not be published.
handling.editorial_review_required: A person will check it before it goes anywhere.

review.landmarkHelp: Coordinates find the spot; a landmark is what someone tells a driver.

review.privatePropertyHelp: Inside a home, or its gate or entrance.
review.publicPlaceHelp: A street, market or open ground.
review.queuedBody: It will upload automatically when you are online.

review.showLocationHelp: Turn off to hide the place and remove it from the map.
review.showTimeHelp: Turn off to publish only the date.
review.storedRegardless: Hidden values are still recorded for review and lawful requests. They are never shown publicly.
review.title: Review report
review.needDescription: Add a short description before sending.

safety.dontExpose: Do not film victims, casualties or children up close.
safety.dontObstruct: Do not get in the way of fire, ambulance or police crews.
safety.dontProvoke: Do not provoke anyone or stage what you are filming.
safety.dontRisk: Do not put yourself at risk to get the shot.
safety.dontTrespass: Do not enter private property or restricted areas.
safety.emergencyFirst: If someone is in immediate danger, call 112 first. Filming is not help.

settings.anonymousDefaultHelp: Your profile stays hidden. A device ID is still recorded.

review.title: With the editors
review.body: Every report is read by an editor before it goes anywhere. They decide whether it runs on the feed and which organisations it should reach.
review.bodyPublic: Every report is read by an editor before it goes anywhere, and nothing reaches the feed except by an editor putting it there. You chose the public feed, so it is not offered to any organisation.

published.title: Published to the public feed
published.body: An editor ran it on the feed. Anyone can see it now.
published.bodyPublic: An editor ran it on the feed. Anyone can see it now.

rejected.title: Not published
rejected.body: An editor decided not to run this one.
rejected.bodyPublic: An editor decided not to run this one.

restricted.title: Held back
restricted.body: It is on the record but is not being shown publicly.
restricted.bodyPublic: It is on the record but is not being shown publicly.

outcome.notRoutedYetBody: An editor passes it to the organisations it concerns once they have reviewed it.
outcome.title: What happened

deskOnly.approval: Granting an organisation access to the public’s footage means reading its screening result and its documents. That is desk work, and it is done at dawuro.gh/platform.
deskOnly.hereBody: The queue, and where each item has got to. Enough to know whether something needs attention before you are back at a desk.
deskOnly.payout: Releasing a batch moves real money and cannot be undone. It is done at dawuro.gh/platform, where the ledger it reconciles against is visible.
deskOnly.title: Decided in the console

MAINTENANCE.title: Dawuro is being updated
MAINTENANCE.body: The service is briefly down for maintenance. Your reports are safe on this phone and will send once it is back.

NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE.title: No connection
NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE.body: Nothing was lost. Anything you have filed stays queued on this phone and sends when you are back online.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
RATE_LIMITED.body: Give it a moment and try again.

TOKEN_EXPIRED.title: Signed out
TOKEN_EXPIRED.body: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on.

TOKEN_INVALID.title: Signed out
TOKEN_INVALID.body: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again to carry on.

FORBIDDEN.title: Not available on this account
FORBIDDEN.body: This account does not have access to that. If you think it should, contact your organisation’s administrator.

SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.title: Create an account to see this
SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.body: Reports you file as a guest still reach the newsroom, but tracking them, and any payment for them, needs an account. It takes a moment and your queued reports stay put.

GPS_ACCURACY_REJECTED.title: Location not accurate enough
GPS_ACCURACY_REJECTED.body: The report needs a tighter GPS fix than your phone had. Move into the open and try again.

MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.title: File too large
MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.body: This recording is bigger than the service accepts. A shorter clip will send.

MEDIA_HASH_MISMATCH.title: Upload was corrupted
MEDIA_HASH_MISMATCH.body: The file changed on the way up. It will be sent again automatically.

UPLOAD_EXPIRED.title: Upload timed out
UPLOAD_EXPIRED.body: This upload took too long and has to start again. Your footage is still on the phone.

INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Report not found
INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND.body: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.

INTERNAL.title: Something went wrong at our end
INTERNAL.body: This is not your connection. Try again shortly.
